chunks: From him, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Abī Ayyūb, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام.
Concerning the muḥṣan man and the muḥṣanah woman: one hundred lashes, then stoning.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام, the source of the reported ruling
key_terms.الرَّجْمُ: stoning as a legal punishment in this ruling
key_terms.الْمُحْصَنَةِ: a legally protected married woman in the context of zina rulings
key_terms.الْمُحْصَنِ: a legally protected married man in the context of zina rulings
key_terms.جَلْدُ: flogging as a prescribed legal punishment
key_terms.مِائَةٍ: one hundred, specifying the number of lashes

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for zina committed by a muḥṣan man or muḥṣanah woman in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the punishment for zina committed by a muḥṣan man and a muḥṣanah woman. It presents the ruling as one hundred lashes followed by stoning, and belongs to the chapter on the legal limits concerning zina.
